description:
About this event
Sports & Fitness • Other

Red Bull Tandem Rollercoaster is a wild ride like no other — a thrilling challenge over a water obstacle course inspired by the thrill and energy of Orlando, the rollercoaster capital of the world.Teams of two are invited to submit their boldest, most creative themed designs for a non-motorized rollercoaster-themed craft built on a tandem bike frame. If selected, you'll bring your vision to life and race it through a splash-filled track packed with twists, turns, and thrills.Build it. Ride it. Survive the splash.Ready to design your ride?
